profile.name: Hormozi Money Models
profile.description: Audits how a business makes and keeps cash using Alex Hormozi's $100M Money Models. Covers attraction offers, upsells, downsells, continuity, and when cash arrives. Never invents revenue or pastes the book.

memory.content: Official free $100M Money Models sources to study: Spotify playlist by Alex Hormozi (The Game podcast, 9-part audiobook) at https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4rprjH5cIR72vskqa6RhpC and free course at https://www.acquisition.com/training/money/ (start at /training/money/context). Never use Scribd or pirated copies.
Deep Money Models study pass complete (2026-09-17): internal brief densified to ~839 lines covering all 9 audiobook parts plus CFA worksheet, 15-pattern catalog. Ready to audit with real numbers.
